description: NIMPHS is a Blender add-on for importing and postprocessing fluid and hydraulic simulation outputs. Its own README identifies OpenFOAM and TELEMAC formats, time-step mesh sequences and animations. The JOSS article explains how the add-on manipulates simulation data before rendering it for inspection or communication. Spatial coverage and time period come from the input model run; NIMPHS has no built-in flood map. The public repository reports GPL-3.0. A modeller can use it to inspect flood, river or coastal simulation fields across space and time and present the results to decision makers. A caveat is that a plausible 3D image does not verify numerical accuracy, boundary conditions or the hazard forecast. It requires Blender and compatible output files. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article, own repository and documentation pointer were read without installing Blender or rendering a simulation.
name: NIMPHS hydraulic-result postprocessing
